summary.headline: Volume-lane sample showed no overpayment; level review could not get a random sample
summary.rationale: 1000000050 billed 99215 on 9.4% of 2,394 claims against an expected 4.4% given patient complexity (risk-adjusted score 3.69; plain z-score vs peers 0.58). 34% of this provider's 99215 claims were on patients with 0 or 1 chronic conditions. Records came back for 0 claims. No documented 99215 claims came back. 2.14x expected 99215 share, ask advice ASK. Of the 30 stratum claims, 26 charts came back, with a negative point estimate and a lower bound of 0. The tool refused a separate level-review sample, so there is no chart basis for an upcoding call. Examples: C0029779: billed 99215, patient aged 28 with 0 chronic condition(s). C0029816: billed 99215, patient aged 88 with 0 chronic condition(s).
